problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Minimize F=f+ψ over a convex measurable set Q; f is convex on E and ψ is convex on Q. A minimizer exists. Strong convexity is not required.

problem_class.label: composite
problem_class.details: The objective combines differentiable f with a possibly nonsmooth convex ψ and constraints Q, accessed through exact proximal minimization.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: At x, returns g(x,ξ) with E[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x). Oracle seeds are independent and identically distributed; the gradient map is jointly measurable.

oracle.label: proximal
oracle.details: For a>0, returns an exact minimizer over Q of ||u−z||²/(2a)+⟨v,u−z⟩+ψ(u). Gradient and proximal queries consume the same single oracle budget; neither function values nor exact gradients are supplied separately.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.lean: Query, proxObjective; LongTails/Setups/StochasticCompositeGeneralizedSmooth.lean: spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: Setup.numOracles, executeWithTrace.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: The gradient is continuous. Whenever its norm is bounded by M along [x,y], ||∇f(x)−∇f(y)||≤(L0+L1 M)||x−y||, with L0>0 and L1≥0.

distinctive_assumptions.label: heavy_tailed_noise
distinctive_assumptions.details: Uniform central moment bound E||g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)||^α≤σ^α, with public σ≥0 and 1<α≤2. For α<2, finite variance is not required.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: E is a real Hilbert space with a second-countable topology and compatible Borel measurable structure; finite dimension is not required. Public parameters include L0,L1,R,Δ,x0,σ,α,ε,δ. A common minimizer x* satisfies ||x0−x*||≤R, F(x0)−F(x*)≤Δ, and ||∇f(x*)||≤G. G≥0 is hidden from the algorithm constructor but appears in its budget. No boundedness of Q is assumed.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.lean: Public; LongTails/Setups/StochasticCompositeGeneralizedSmooth.lean: Public, Params, spec.publicInput, spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The measurable output X must satisfy F(X)−F(x*)≤ε for a minimizer x*, jointly with feasibility on the success event; ε>0.

accuracy.label: feasibility
accuracy.details: The failure event includes X∉Q; feasibility and objective accuracy must hold together.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: P{X∉Q or F(X)−F(x*)>ε}≤δ, with 0<δ<1, under the joint algorithm and oracle randomness and a fixed total oracle-call budget.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The setup combines composite proximal optimization in a Hilbert space with gradient-dependent generalized smoothness, finite central α-moment noise, and high-probability accuracy. Its hidden bound on the smooth gradient at a composite minimizer further distinguishes it from standard smooth stochastic convex benchmarks.
